description: Sixteen step sequencer built to be re-rolled: one button scatters the whole sequence, another varies which steps play, a third changes a few of the voltages

params.text: Rolls a whole new sequence: Dens sets how many steps play, and each step has the chance set by Hold of keeping its voltage
Sets how many steps the sequence runs through, 2 to 16
Sets how many of the steps play after a dice roll, 2 to 16
Sets how far a new random voltage can reach from the middle of the range, 0.1V to 10V
The chance that a step keeps its voltage through a dice roll, 0 to 100%
Switches some playing steps to resting and some resting steps to playing, as many of each as Add and Rm ask for
Sets how many resting steps a variation switches to playing, 0 to 6
Sets how many playing steps a variation switches to resting, 0 to 6
Gives new random voltages to a few playing steps, as many as the No knob sets
Sets how many steps a modulation gives new voltages to, 0 to 16
Returns to the first step and brings back the last stored sequence, dropping every variation and modulation
Moves on to the next step
Stores the sequence as it stands now, so a reset comes back to it
Sets the voltage its step puts out, within the range picked in the menu; clicking the knob switches that step between playing and resting

inputs.text: Each rising edge moves on to the next step
A rising edge returns to the first step and brings back the last stored sequence, dropping every variation and modulation
A rising edge rolls a whole new sequence, as the Dice button does
A rising edge gives new random voltages to a few playing steps, as the Mod button does
A rising edge varies which steps play, as the Var button does
A rising edge stores the sequence as it stands now, so a reset comes back to it

outputs.text: Passes the clock through while the step the sequence has reached is playing, and stays at 0V on a resting step
The voltage of the step the sequence has reached

notes: the sequence comes up with every step resting and every voltage at zero: click a knob to switch its step to playing, or press Dice to roll a whole sequence
menu: Range — sets the span of the step knobs; the symmetric choices run -10V to 10V down to -1V to 1V, where it starts, and the positive ones 0V to 1V up to 0V to 10V
Quantize — rounds the output to the nearest semitone
Hold CV on Rest — holds the last voltage through resting steps in place of reading them

inputs.0: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
